title: PyTorch Landscape
summary: A visual landscape/map of the PyTorch ecosystem that categorizes and displays various libraries, tools, frameworks, and projects built around or integrated with PyTorch, similar to CNCF's landscape visualization approach.
problem_solved: Helps developers navigate and discover the growing PyTorch ecosystem by providing a structured overview of available tools, libraries, and extensions.
why_valuable: Makes it easy to explore and find relevant PyTorch-related projects and tools in one consolidated view, saving developers research time when building ML solutions.
